title: typos-format telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the typos-format hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "typos-format". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write or Edit).

file.description: Path of the checked file, relative to the consuming repo root.

findings.description: Residual (unfixable) typos findings remaining after --write-changes. Empty array = clean or fully fixed.

corrections.description: Known correction candidates, or null when the term is disallowed with no known correction.
